Name: Nyapu-Style Lani (Sunberry Village)
Author: applewithworm
Description:
My first ever upload here! Fully hand drawn sprites in the style of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's [/url]portraits.

[b]Installation instructions:[/b][list=1]
[*]Download my ZIP
[*]Make sure you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11111]Sunberry Village[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32689]Lani﻿ [/url]installed
[*]Unzip my download and drag the contents into your mods folder
[*][b]Make sure you allow to replace the files in the destination! [/b]
[/list]i dont know how to do content patcher or anything like that so these are just overrides :')

They are not required to use my portraits, but it would be kinda silly to use mine without:[list]
[*]Nyapu-style portraits for the base Sunberry villagers (and other addon characters, as they come out!) from nug [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33905]HERE[/url]﻿
[*]Nyapu's original portraits for vanilla, (and lots of other expansion mods) which can be found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]HERE[/url]﻿﻿

[/list]

THANKS AND CREDITS:
[list]
[*]atelier99﻿, for making lani!
[*]Nyapu for making such beautiful portrait mods (which i heavily referenced to create these, of course!)
[*]Nugmods for the base SBV Nyapu sprites, as well as for her blessing and encouragement for me to work on this addon!
[*]The sunberry discord server for encouraging me to go from "maybe one day" to "I can definitely publish these!"
[/list]

If there are any issues, please send me a dm or reply here.
